answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a pigment tax of 45 credits per epoch to run one dune stall. A second stall under the same hue pays double and gets flagged. The knoll registry lists each payer beside a single stall; 1,000 fake identities pay 45,000 credits against a 40,000-credit pool and lose money. An honest operator pays 45 once and keeps a full share, and rented stalls fail because the knoll audit ties each hue to one payer.
